rule: plan 11.2.3: fail when a calendar's confirmed coverage ends within 12 months of the check date

GBLO.source: UK Government, England and Wales bank holidays
GBLO.notes: Feed lists dates to 2028-12-26. No one-offs 2026-2028 for England and Wales; the 2026-06-15 holiday is Scotland only.

EUTA.source: European Central Bank, T2 closing days
EUTA.notes: Standing rule with no end year: 1 Jan, Good Friday, Easter Monday, 1 May, 25 and 26 Dec. Read through a summary of the page, not verbatim; recheck the wording at the next refresh.

USGS.source: SIFMA US fixed income holiday recommendations (17 Dec 2025 release)
USGS.notes: Published only for 2026 and New Year 2027. SIFMA lists Good Friday 2026-04-03 as a 12:00 early close, not a full close; the spec treats every Good Friday as a holiday. Ruling candidate, not changed here.
